J.text: If 14th May is a Tuesday, what day of the week is 4th June?
steps: May has 31 days. From 14th to 31st May is 17 days, then to 4th June is 4 more days = 21 days total.

J.text: Statement: Some artists are musicians. All musicians are creative. Conclusion: Some artists are creative. Is this conclusion valid?
